content.text: Digital creators in regions where major [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-4|payment]] platforms are restricted face significant challenges in automating their sales processes. For creators in Nigeria, Kenya, and beyond, the lack of reliable infrastructure means manual order fulfillment often leads to delays and lost sales. Enter Google Apps Script, a powerful tool that can transform how you deliver digital products automatically without relying on Stripe or similar services.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows you to automate tasks across Google Workspace applications. For digital creators, it means streamlining order fulfillment processes. By using Apps Script, you can set up automated workflows that respond to payment confirmations, send download links, and manage inventory, all without manual intervention. This matters because it drastically reduces the time from payment to product delivery, ensuring that your customers receive their purchases almost instantly.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this automated process is a correctly configured sovereign stack, which can process orders in under 30 seconds. When a payment is made via NOWPayments, a webhook triggers a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script. This script then manages tasks like updating inventory, sending emails, and delivering download links. The combination of these components ensures that you can handle up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier of Cloudflare Workers, making your infrastructure both scalable and efficient.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This setup is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to conventional payment platforms is limited or non-existent. Whether you are [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-selling-digital-products-africa-keeps-failing-stack-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-courses-without-teachable-stripe-explained-digital-creators|Selling Courses]] ebooks, courses, or digital art, this infrastructure empowers you to take full control of your sales process. By automating fulfillment and maintaining ownership of your data, you can focus on what you do best: creating. You are no longer at the mercy of external platforms or facing payment delays.
Empower your digital sales with full automation.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components that make this automation possible include Google Apps Script for backend logic, NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, and a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. For product delivery, you can leverage Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring that your digital commerce stack operates smoothly. Together, they create an ecosystem that is efficient, cost-effective, and secure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a robust deployment. First, set up your Cloudflare Pages and configure the Worker for handling webhooks. Next, integrate NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions. After that, create a Supabase database or a Google Sheet for order storage. Finally, implement Google Apps Script to automate your email notifications and product deliveries. You can find the necessary resources and products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by using a webhook to trigger actions after a crypto payment confirms. When a payment is received through NOWPayments, a webhook sends a notification to your backend (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), which processes the order and sends the download link to the buyer's email. This seamless integration helps ensure a quick and efficient transaction experience.
Experience infrastructure sovereignty without platform dependency.

If you're looking for an all-in-one solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). It equips you with the necessary tools to automate your digital sales effectively. Explore more related searches like automated digital delivery and webhook integration to enhance your business strategy further.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by using webhooks to trigger backend scripts that send out download links after a payment is confirmed. When a payment is processed through NOWPayments, the webhook automatically notifies your backend system, which handles order management and delivery seamlessly.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a user-defined HTTP callback that triggers actions when specific events occur. In your setup, a webhook from NOWPayments notifies your server when a payment is confirmed, prompting your backend script to fulfill the order by sending the product to the customer.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, you can automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms. By using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can create a workflow that sends the download link directly to the customer's email once the payment webhook is received.
What tools do I need for this setup?

You'll need Cloudflare Pages or Workers for hosting, NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, and either Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Google Apps Script will handle the automation of email notifications and product delivery.
How quickly can I set this up?
